before.rationale: No data distinguishing the neighborhoods was provided, so this is an arbitrary placeholder choice, not an evidence-based preference. It should be revised once late-night demand and costs for each neighborhood are known.

after.rationale: Synthetic personas near A showed a slightly higher top-two-box share (7/13 vs 7/16) and no '1' ratings, a weak directional lean toward A. The subgroups are tiny and synthetic, and rent, zoning and competition remain unknown, so this is a tentative lean rather than a firm preference.

changedAssumptions.before: Neither neighborhood has been described, so any preference between them is currently unsupported.
changedAssumptions.after: Only weak synthetic-panel demand signals distinguish the neighborhoods, so any preference remains largely unsupported.

changedAssumptions.before: A late-night café's viability depends mainly on sustained demand after typical business hours, not daytime traffic.
changedAssumptions.after: A late-night café's viability depends mainly on sustained after-hours demand, which synthetic personas suggest also hinges on safety, cleanliness, reliable hours and fair pricing.

supporting: q3: Top-two-box likelihood was 7/13 (about half) among A personas vs 7/16 among B personas.
q3: All four lowest ('1') ratings came from B personas; A had none.
contradicting: q1: More personas lived near B (16 vs 13), so the absolute count of likely visitors was equal (7 each).
q2: Frequency of late-night outings was not reported by neighborhood, so overall demand may not differ between A and B.
q4: Expected spend clustered at $5-10 and was not broken out by neighborhood, giving no revenue advantage to A.
limitations: Responses come from 30 AI-generated personas, not real residents, and the run was uncalibrated.
Neighborhood subgroups (A n=13, B n=16) are far too small to support a reliable difference.
The study did not address rent, zoning or permitted hours, competition, or transit access.
Stated likelihood to visit a hypothetical café may overstate actual behavior.
Q5 theme counts could not be filtered to this run, though the base matches.

confidenceBefore.reason: No information about either neighborhood was given, so the recommendation is a placeholder resting entirely on assumptions.
